premises.text: Existing app security (periodic audits, scanners with false positives, permissive firewalls) leaves a persistent gap between development and security as apps ship fast
premises.evidence_span: security audits cannot be performed each time your code is changed

premises.text: Screen protects applications at runtime by monitoring critical in-app functions with logic-based blocking of unknown vulnerabilities and low false positives
premises.evidence_span: Screen is a security solution that protects your application at runtime

premises.text: Installs like a dependency in a few commands and shows developers debugger-like attack details, backtraces, and user-protection signals in one dashboard
premises.evidence_span: installing screen is not different from installing any other dependency in your application

premises.text: Pricing starts at $99/month and scales with hosts; available for Python, Rails, and Node.js
premises.evidence_span: our pricing starts at only $99 per month and scales as you grow with the number of hosts
